text.tspan: A resource's title (generated search_vector):
with / as a space, and as name words
(h2_name_words: split at / . _ @ :), both A, simple
Query words (plainWords):
/ as a space, search syntax removed
README of a list read in this pass
(top 10 lists, up to 5 MB)
Caps per list: at most max-entries-per-pass entries,
256 KiB of entry text and heading path,
16 KiB of headings
Hits: this run's slice of entries (AI only)
+ each list read, as an ARTICLE tagged awesome-list
RunScout: hits indexed first,
then the list text to the list index
A failed list index: logged,
the pass goes on; the next one rebuilds it
Card: "Found in <list> under <heading>"
when every source found it only in a list
Heading: plain words, at most 200 chars;
opens its level, closes deeper ones
Entry: GitHub link, not the list itself,
not a GitHub page; line as plain words
(no links, badges, HTML, URLs, control
or bidi chars), at most 500 chars;
heading path from level 2 down, at most 200
Delete the list's entry rows;
insert one row per entry in the catalog:
tsvector (line with / as a space
and its name words A, heading path B)
+ heading path as text
Upsert the list's row:
tsvector of its headings
Direct row: every word +2,
popularity, half the text score
An entry line or a list's
headings match? (GIN)
List-only row: counts half
(every word +1, half popularity)
